answer: Falcon-eyed mutual audits make fake identities a liability. Each epoch, a random beacon assigns K auditors to every identity, each checking claimed work against the umber-inked audit trail. Proven fraud slashes the 100-credit bond: half burns, half rewards the auditor, and auditors who cover fraud are slashed jointly. Minting 1,000 fakes locks 100,000 credits and faces 1,000xK checks, so losses grow linearly with N, never recycled. An honest agent locks 100 once, passes by working, and earns bounties for catching fraud. Each report must be complete as a sonnet: fourteen lines, no filler.
